Subject: Production latency spike — request for remedy

Hi Priyom,

We experienced a sustained latency regression across our inference calls between 2028-03-12 22:05 UTC and 2028-03-13 02:45 UTC. Tail p95/p99 token latency increased by ~3-4x and caused queuing in our request pipeline — we saw multiple customer-facing errors as a result.

Our account is on dedicated capacity (BK-2028-07). We opened a support ticket (INF-4682). Can you confirm the root cause, and let us know what remedial steps Redwood can offer in terms of credits, trial extension, or other goodwill measures? This has put our trial-to-paid conversion at risk.

I've attached a short log excerpt and the CI trace that shows request IDs and timestamps. Please loop in SRE and legal as needed.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations
BlueOak Analytics

Subject: RE: Production latency spike — request for remedy

Hi all,

Investigation notes:
- Root cause: regression introduced in autoscaling policy for the dedicated pool that delayed replenishment under a burst pattern; a hot-shard kept depleting worker slots for ~4h.
- Impact window observed: 2028-03-12 22:05 UTC — 2028-03-13 02:45 UTC.
- P95 increased from ~120ms to ~410ms; P99 spiked from ~420ms to ~1.7s.
- No data exfiltration; configuration rollback mitigated the issue at 02:45 UTC.

Attached: incident_report-BlueOak-20280313.pdf (full timeline) and SLA_calculation-BlueOak-20280314.xlsx (impact calc, token counts, invoice prorate model).

Initial suggestion for a commercial remedy (subject to legal/finance sign-off):
- Credit equivalent to 5% of March invoice (prorated to impacted API scope), plus
- 14-day trial extension for any trial seats impacted.

Rationale: the incident is production-impacting but the dedicated pool rollback restored full capacity within ~4 hours; recommended gesture aligns with precedent for similar incident class.

Happy to hop on a quick call with Samir to walk through the calculations.

— Marissa
SRE, Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Subject: RE: Production latency spike — request for remedy

Thanks Marissa — good write-up.

Given BlueOak is in a trial-to-paid flow and the account sensitivity, I recommend we be a touch more generous to avoid churn. Proposed commercial offer (pending LAU/legal):
- 7% credit on March invoice (vs Marissa’s 5%), applied to the next bill;
- 30-day trial extension for the impacted seats;
- One complimentary onboarding session from Solutions Eng (1 hour).

We should run this by Lauren (legal/finance) because their MSA has a limited SLA credit clause and we need to ensure we’re not committing beyond standard terms without exec sign-off. Deal: BK-2028-07 — if we can get a quick approval I’ll push the acceptance path in HubSpot and offer a DocuSign consent for the amendment.

-Jonas
